title: Back Pain
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} presents with chronic low back pain (>3 months), morning stiffness (>30 min) that IMPROVES with exercise and WORSENS with rest. Inflammatory back pain pattern (vs mechanical — worsens with activity). Associated: sacroiliitis, limited spinal mobility (Schober test), enthesitis, peripheral arthritis, uveitis. Young male predominance. Strong association with HLA-B27. Diagnosis: X-ray/MRI of SI joints — sacroiliitis (bamboo spine in advanced disease). Elevated ESR/CRP. Treatment: NSAIDs first-line (excellent response — diagnostic feature). Physical therapy — maintain posture and mobility. If NSAIDs insufficient → TNF inhibitors (infliximab, adalimumab, etanercept). IL-17 inhibitors (secukinumab) also effective. Do NOT recommend bed rest — makes it worse. Exercise program essential.
chief_complaint: Chronic low back pain, morning stiffness improved by exercise
